title: Orbital Decay
target_audience: Adults 25-49; hybrid theatrical release followed by mid-window SVOD streaming
logline: When a routine maintenance crew on a low-Earth orbit satellite array loses communication with ground control during a global blackout, they must pilot a damaged supply shuttle back to an unpowered Earth while dodging hyper-velocity space debris.

title: Rustbelt Sonata
target_audience: Adults 35-65; festival circuit (Sundance/Telluride) targeting specialized platform theatrical and micro-budget PVOD release
logline: A disgraced classical pianist returns to her dying Ohio industrial hometown to care for her estranged, ailing father and takes a job teaching music at a underfunded community center facing imminent demolition.

title: Apex Velocity
target_audience: Males and Females 18-49; wide global theatrical release with premium large-format (IMAX/Dolby Cinema) rollout
logline: A veteran off-road endurance racer is coerced back into the driver's seat by defense contractors to pilot an experimental, high-speed tactical prototype through a hostile desert warzone to rescue stranded engineers before enemy forces breach the border.

title: Drafting Love
target_audience: Females 18-49; direct-to-streaming SVOD premiere with targeted holiday window push
logline: Two rival fantasy sports strategists accidentally sign up for the same co-living apartment lease during a city housing crunch and must navigate their growing attraction while competing for the same executive sports-analytics promotion.
